_about: 30 fictional postings with hand-labelled must-haves and nice-to-haves, for PromptEvals (T39). Labels name each requirement the posting lists, conditions such as work authorization or French included; a predicted requirement matches a label when they share a technology or most of the label's words.

postings.title: Backend Developer II
postings.description:
## About us
Northline Freight moves two million shipments a year across Canada. We're a small, profitable team that ships every week. We offer health and dental benefits, a learning budget and flexible hours.
## What you'll do
- Build and run the services that track shipments in real time.
- Work with product on carrier integrations.
## Requirements
- 3+ years building backend services in Go or Java
- Strong PostgreSQL skills
- Experience with message queues such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
- Legally entitled to work in Canada
## Nice to have
- Kubernetes
- gRPC
We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone.
musts: 3+ years building backend services in Go or Java
Message queues such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Legally entitled to work in Canada
